globalProperty.value: SELECT DISTINCT p.uuid, pi.identifier, pn.given_name AS givenName, pn.middle_name AS middleName, pn.family_name AS familyName, pa.value AS phoneNumber, p.gender AS gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE()) AS age, p.date_created, p.person_id AS lastPersonId FROM person p JOIN person_name pn ON pn.person_id = p.person_id AND pn.preferred = 1 AND pn.voided = 0 JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.preferred = 1 AND pi.voided = 0 JOIN patient_identifier_type pit ON pi.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id JOIN global_property gp ON gp.property = 'bahmni.primaryIdentifierType' AND gp.property_value = pit.uuid JOIN location l ON l.uuid = ${identifiersourcelocation} JOIN person_attribute pa ON pa.person_id = p.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN location_attribute_type lat ON lat.name = 'IdentifierSourceName' LEFT JOIN location_attribute la ON la.location_id = l.location_id AND la.attribute_type_id = lat.location_attribute_type_id AND la.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN person_attribute_type pa_type ON pa_type.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id AND pa_type.name = 'phoneNumber' WHERE p.voided = 0 AND (la.value_reference IS NULL OR pi.identifier LIKE CONCAT(la.value_reference, '%')) AND ( ${last_person_id} IS NULL OR ${last_person_id} = '' OR p.person_id > ${last_person_id} ) AND ( ${name} IS NULL OR TRIM(${name}) = '' OR pn.given_name LIKE CASE WHEN TRIM(${name}) = '%' THEN '%' ELSE CONCAT('%', TRIM(${name}), '%') END OR pn.middle_name LIKE CASE WHEN TRIM(${name}) = '%' THEN '%' ELSE CONCAT('%', TRIM(${name}), '%') END OR pn.family_name LIKE CASE WHEN TRIM(${name}) = '%' THEN '%' ELSE CONCAT('%', TRIM(${name}), '%') END ) AND ( ${identifier} IS NULL OR TRIM(${identifier}) = '' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM patient_identifier all_pi WHERE all_pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND all_pi.voided = 0 AND all_pi.identifier LIKE CASE WHEN TRIM(${identifier}) = '%' THEN '%' ELSE CONCAT('%', TRIM(${identifier}), '%') END ) ) AND ( ${customAttribute} IS NULL OR TRIM(${customAttribute}) = '' OR pa.value LIKE CASE WHEN TRIM(${customAttribute}) = '%' THEN '%' ELSE CONCAT('%', TRIM(${customAttribute}), '%') END ) ORDER BY p.date_created DESC LIMIT 50;
